name: Four Seasons Las Vegas
positioning: A non-gaming and non-smoking hotel on the south end of the Las Vegas Strip, adjacent to Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino
best_for: Travelers who want a non-gaming and non-smoking hotel on the Strip
Guests who want a Forbes Five-Star spa and a private pool, with access to the Mandalay Bay pools

facts.text: The hotel has a total of 424 rooms.
The hotel's guest rooms comprise floors 35 to 39 of a 43-floor building.
The hotel is a non-gaming and non-smoking hotel.
The hotel is adjacent to the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino.
The hotel is on the south end of the Las Vegas Strip.
The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Harry Reid International Airport.
Veranda – California Brasserie serves breakfast, lunch or weekend brunch.
Bourbon Steak at the hotel is led by James Beard Award-winner Chef Michael Mina.
PRESS is the hotel's indoor-outdoor lounge, with craft cocktails as its cornerstone.
In-room dining is served 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: The hotel has a Forbes Five-Star Spa.
Four Seasons guests have access to the Mandalay Bay Pools complex, which houses a Lazy River, three swimming pools and a real-sand beach.
The hotel's private pool offers hourly complimentary passed amenities such as Evian spritzes and frozen fruit skewers.
The hotel has eight private pool cabanas.
The Strip View Room has floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.

considerations.text: Spa hours of operation and spa services are subject to seasonal change.
The hotel's private pool is seasonal.
The Four Seasons Pool is open 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the Las Vegas market.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
